Thank you for caring.
Oct 2024 • Couples
Surprisingly, there were few restaurants serving Vietnamese food on the street where this restaurant is located, and it was quite used by locals as well as tourists.

Because it is not eating and comparing, I will leave out the details, but I think the taste is very general

There are comments that the price is high, but that can not be helped considering the location conditions

Downtown areas in other countries are more expensive than in rural areas, so you should check the menu before visiting

I think this restaurant is one of the cheapest for foreigners.

I went there twice during my stay. I always bring my own chopsticks from Japan, but when I accidentally dropped them on the floor before eating, a staff girl noticed and brought them from the back (the type you can get at a convenience store in Japan) - even though of course there are chopsticks on the table!
The noodles in the photo show a little split♪

They seem to have mixed reviews of the staff, but they also speak good English and were impressed by the unexpected care we received when we visited

But Banh mi was certainly hard and small (laughs)

Watch out for a scam
Mar 2023 • Solo
WARNING! Watch out for a scam if you are paying with credit card

I ordered a sandwich which costs 85,000 VND. I paid with a credit card, and the cashier did not give me a receipt. The I left the shop. After living in Vietnam for a while, I had my suspicion (if you know what I mean), so I checked my banking app, and BAMM I got charged 850,000 VND. I returned to the shop to ask for refund; the lady there said it was a genuine mistake and gave me refund in cash, but I find that very convenient... (Additional zero and the fact that she did not offer me the receipt)

Will never go back to the shop again

Watch out guys

Written March 21, 2023
Wanderer31451009265
Lời đầu tiên Lebanhmi xin cảm ơn bạn đã đến và trải nghiệm món ăn tại Lebanhmi. Thật sự những phản hồi của bạn làm cửa hàng rất buồn, đây là nhưng phản hồi không hoàn toàn chính xác 100% mọi thứ diễn ra. Chúng tôi đã nhận đây là sai sót của nhân viên trực quầy thanh toán. Và chúng tôi đã xin lỗi rất chân thành cũng như hoàn tiền đầy đủ cho phần tiền sai sót đó. Bạn đã rất vui vẻ nhưng cuối cùng lại có những đánh giá rất tiêu cực về quán, tôi không nghĩ đây là một hành động quá đẹp. Thời gian sau khi quẹt thẻ tới khi bạn vòng lại chưa tới 1p, và tất cả đều có thông báo khi trừ tiền, vậy làm sao chúng tôi dám làm điều tệ hại như vậy. Chúng tôi có hiển thị tổng số tiền thanh toán đơn hàng tại màn hình thanh toán, vậy tại sao bạn lại nói chúng tôi lừa bạn. Rất xin lỗi bạn vì những trải nghiệm không đáng có lần này. Mong bạn có một chuyến đi tuyệt vời tại Việt Nam

Dissapointing
Jun 2017 • Couples
Had eaten here before when in Vietnam for the first time.

I had trouble finding the place this time as they moved around the cornet and was under new ownership.

Not only had the location changed but so had the quality and taste of the food. The sandwich lacked the zest of flavor that I remember existed but the price was still the same.

Basically what once was good was now nothing special anymore. Did not paying their higher price for good taste but now it is just the same as any other.

As this is a rapidly changing city I guess one unfortunately cannot expect things to stay the same.
